_about: The picture models the setup page (Gate 1) offers, in this order; default is preselected. Each run picks one; every scene, title card and character sheet of that run is drawn with it. params are sent to mcp__higgsfield__generate_image as they are, plus prompt, aspect_ratio, count, use_unlim and medias. credits = one 16:9 picture at these params, quoted with get_cost on 2026-11-11.
